Tax uses banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This comes from an EngramDB decision made with the finance team in March 2026, and it says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

The code doesn't show it yet. `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` is still `raise NotImplementedError`, and nothing in the repo calls `ROUND_*`, `quantize` or `round()`. So the decision is recorded but not implemented. Whoever implements `tax_for` should apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
